Every original student, reviewed.

All 24 original answer payloads are unchanged. An independent reviewer inspected every case. Original results are retained beside candidate-engine results; biography-based reinterpretations are separate.

These older narrative seeds sometimes name a career. Added childhood events are fictional backfill. Their parallel answers are not independent student evidence or a correct-career answer key.

Ari: biology and diagnosis · m32-medical-reasoning

Ari enjoys explaining why illness happens, comparing explanations, and listening to people. A biology presentation and a supervised hospital information-desk shift increased curiosity about consultations. Ari is willing to explore college, medical school and residency, and imagines a modest independent life while training. The aim is useful work with room to keep learning, not a guaranteed physician outcome.

Review: sensible exploration; financial conclusion conditional

Diagnosis, physician observation, and physician-route choices supply role-specific support. Residency pay is correctly selected rather than attending pay, and the full plan distinguishes roughly 11 postsecondary years. The $69,528 example leaves only about $85 monthly under a zero-debt lifestyle; $399,818 remains unfunded in the education scenario.

Jules: precise oral care · m32-dental-precision

Jules likes biology, careful model-making and explaining routines to younger cousins. An approved dental observation made restoring a damaged tooth more interesting than broad hospital diagnosis. Jules will consider college prerequisites and dental school but wants to compare costs before committing. Savings matter more than a premium car.

Review: sensible exploration; financial conclusion conditional

Restorative dentistry and dental-route answers discriminate this from general medicine. Entry pay is qualified-dentist pay, not study income. A $512,922 reference route remains unfunded while the lifestyle displays coverage with $0 loan payments.

Sam: interested but untried care · m32-novice-care

Sam likes helping a relative follow everyday routines and notices small changes in how people feel. Sam enjoys biology but has not had access to a clinic, lab club or paid work. Nursing observation seems more appealing than diagnosing alone. Sam speaks cautiously about ability, wants help learning, and is open to a nursing program without assuming graduate study.

Review: sensible match; actual preparation-cost defect

Monitoring patients and preferring RN work support nursing despite limited exposure and low confidence; neither is evidence of inability. However nursing's varied credential classification falls through to $0 cost and zero study years even though the app itself requires an approved nursing program and exams. The export reduces preparation to RN licensure only.

  • Complete the Board application and fingerprinting.

Lee: diagnosis with a short-route preference · m32-care-route-tension

Lee is fascinated by differential diagnosis and explains case stories from a school health club. Lee currently hopes to start earning quickly and chooses dental assisting preparation, despite preferring physician responsibilities in the role questions. These are two real preferences to discuss rather than proof the routes are interchangeable. Lee wants an expensive future lifestyle before understanding its training timeline.

Review: appropriate unresolved conflict

The app preserves physician-duty interest as a route conflict and assigns no career or financial projection after the dental-assisting preparation choice. It does not equate the routes or use the expensive lifestyle to infer aptitude. A counselor discussion or side-by-side routes is the appropriate next step.

Ren: revising visual messages · m32-visual-editor

Ren likes choosing type, color and layout, showing drafts to classmates, and improving a message after feedback. Drawing is enjoyable; public performance and sales are not. Ren wants to compare graphic design and interface design, can consider a degree or practical study, and accepts shared housing to protect time for creative work.

Review: sensible exploration

Layout, readability, and visual-identity answers directly support graphic design. UI design can remain a related possibility, not a required winning output. The selected entry wage fails the fixed lifestyle budget; shared housing alone does not establish affordability. Typical degree language is appropriately not an absolute requirement.

Noor: writing without performance · m32-quiet-writer

Noor spends free time revising fiction, checking facts for the school magazine, and finding a precise word. Music, dance, visual effects and acting do not appeal, so a broad artistic label may obscure this specific writing interest. Noor dislikes persuasion and clinical care, values quiet autonomy, and will explore college writing or another route with a portfolio.

Review: writing sensible; interpreting insufficiently differentiated

Eight focused writing/story answers justify task-led writing even with weak broad-profile correlation. Interpreting is featured from four shared meaning, audience, and research prompts; no answer establishes interest in communicating across languages. Its high profile correlation cannot supply that missing role evidence. It is permissible as a question to investigate, but overstates support if presented as an equally evidenced career.

Imani: science and illustration · m32-biology-stories

Imani enjoys pond observations and explaining the findings through drawings, diagrams and short stories. A science fair felt best when visitors understood the poster. Patient care does not attract Imani, and neither science nor creative work should erase the other interest. Imani is willing to compare degrees and keeps future spending moderate.

Review: permissible mixed-interest exploration

The narrative alone might suggest science communication, but actual answers favor scene timing, mood, movement, and imagery, so film editing and visual alternatives are defensible. Science remains a task pathway. The harness explicitly chose writing from named alternatives; that financial plan is not an accidental reassignment or a predicted identity. Degree summary is now role-based rather than automatic English/literature.
